ROUTER DNS ROUTING
Every device's lookups go through a tunnel: pinned devices' through their own, every other device's through VPN Director's rule for the whole network.
read 04:09:30

== YOUR DEVICES' LOOKUPS ==
wgc1:pia-aus_perth → 9.9.9.9 [wgc1:pia-aus_perth, encrypted to PIA] - TABLET
Everything else → 9.9.9.9 [wgc5:pia-aus_melbourne, encrypted to PIA] - VPN Director's rule for 192.168.1.0/24

== THE ROUTER'S OWN LOOKUPS ==
127.0.0.1 dnsmasq → stubby → 1.1.1.2, 1.0.0.2 [Internet, encrypted (DoT)] - local caching DNS server, DNS-over-TLS

== THE SLOTS' DNS SERVERS ==
9.9.9.9, 149.112.112.112 [shared by 4] - used by wgc1:pia-aus_perth, wgc2:pia-au_adelaide-pf, wgc3:pia-au_brisbane-pf and wgc5:pia-aus_melbourne.

== EVIDENCE ==

DNS routing rules (ip rule, iif lo)
Merlin has no such rules. It sends the router's own lookups to a slot's DNS servers by its main table, through the first slot to start. THE SLOTS' DNS SERVERS says which slot that is.
(none)

DNS redirects (VPN Director's DNSVPN chains)
Lookups to the router from each device VPN Director sends to a tunnel, sent on to that slot's DNS servers.
-A DNSVPN6 -s 192.168.1.55/32 -j DNAT --to-destination 9.9.9.9
-A DNSVPN6 -s 192.168.1.55/32 -j DNAT --to-destination 149.112.112.112
-A DNSVPN10 -s 192.168.1.0/24 -j DNAT --to-destination 9.9.9.9

Slot DNS settings (nvram)
Each slot's DNS servers, as set in MANAGE or the web interface.
wgc1_dns=9.9.9.9, 149.112.112.112  # wgc1:pia-aus_perth
wgc2_dns=9.9.9.9, 149.112.112.112  # wgc2:pia-au_adelaide-pf
wgc3_dns=9.9.9.9, 149.112.112.112  # wgc3:pia-au_brisbane-pf
wgc4_dns=  # not configured
wgc5_dns=9.9.9.9, 149.112.112.112  # wgc5:pia-aus_melbourne
